messages:
Maya (Product): Quick sync — we need to finalize the operator playbook for private deploys that do IP reuse during upgrades. Framing a sprint to ship runbook + preflight automation. :spiral_calendar:
Liam (Eng): What's the target constraint? low downtime vs zero-touch? :thinking_face:
Maya (Product): Field feedback: most customers prioritize predictability over zero downtime. Our proposal: guarantee <15m rolling for leapfrog path, and provide sidecar-relay as lower-risk option.
Kevin (Network): Important detail: leapfrog requires egress IP continuity for outbound webhooks and fixed IP ACLs. If we can't preserve, customers need an IP rebind plan.
Sophia (Field Ops): From the field: two customers refused upgrades because of IP churn. They want a pre-approved maintenance window + automated announce to NetOps.
Liam (Eng): Proposed gated checklist for GA: 1) `installer check --ip-collision` preflight; 2) dry-run mode that simulates NAT translation; 3) post-upgrade verifier.
Kevin (Network): Post-upgrade verifier (stub):
```
#!/bin/bash
# verify egress IPs and BGP
curl -s https://ifconfig.io | grep "$EXPECTED_EGRESS"
bgpctl show neighbors | grep Established
```
If either fails -> auto rollback trigger (unless overridden).
Maya (Product): Rollback policy suggestion: revert if >2 critical endpoints fail healthcheck for >5m. Document as SLA escape hatch.
Sophia (Field Ops): Field ops notes we should include: exact logs to collect, contact matrix, and customer-facing email template. I can draft templates.
Liam (Eng): Who owns rollout automation? Eng-runtime or Eng-platform? We need an owner to build `installer check` and `post-upgrade verifier`.
Kevin (Network): Eng-infra owns preflight checks; runtime will own the live migration bits. I'll sync with infra on required telemetry hooks.
Maya (Product): Owners: Liam -> preflight & verifier; Kevin -> network validation & egress policy; Sophia -> operator runbook + templates. Sprint target: end of next sprint (2 weeks). :shipit:
opsbot: deployment-note: created #private-deploy-onramp runbook draft in Google Drive (link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/runbook-draft) :link:
Sophia (Field Ops): I'll add checklist items and customer templates by EOD tomorrow. Assigning follow-ups in Notion.
Liam (Eng): I'll stub `installer check` this week and add unit tests for ip-detection. ETA Thurs.
Maya (Product): Perfect. Next sync Fri 11am PT. Add any blockers before then. :white_check_mark:
